records.claim: Key Middle East crude exports rebounded to 12.8 mbd in September; Hormuz exports were set to reach about 7.4 mbd; Saudi exports about 5.4 mbd; Ras Tanura about 3.6 mbd.
records.observation: Physical export flow through Gulf routes recovered materially from August while remaining about 6 mbd below February regional exports.
records.assessment: Supports upward revision of Gulf crude export flow; does not support RESOLVED status for Hormuz.

records.claim: After damage to the East-West Pipeline, Saudi Arabia increased eastern Gulf loadings and arranged large volumes for ship-to-ship transfer around Sohar.
records.observation: The Yanbu bypass was impaired and Saudi export routing shifted back toward Gulf terminals and Hormuz.
records.assessment: Establishes the routing mechanism underlying Issue 0001 rather than a new September 28 event.

records.claim: East-West Pipeline operations resumed at a reduced rate; full restoration could take six to eight weeks after damage to three pumping stations.
records.observation: The principal Hormuz bypass is recovering but is not yet restored to full operating capability.
records.assessment: Supports RECOVERING / PARTIAL rather than operational-normal state.

records.claim: Gulf of Oman STS activity is approaching practical limits; further scaling may shift activity toward West Coast India or Malaysia and sharply increase VLCC requirements.
records.observation: The adaptation route itself is developing a capacity constraint and longer-distance alternatives reduce vessel productivity.
records.assessment: Supports ADAPTATION SATURATING and bottleneck migration. India/Malaysia remain possible next-stage adaptations, not confirmed new crude flows.

records.claim: China may allow some domestic companies including ByteDance and Alibaba to buy Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 chips; Reuters could not independently verify the report.
records.observation: There is a signal of possible regulatory relaxation but no verified purchase flow.
records.assessment: DEVELOPING / EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT. No upward flow change is recorded.

records.claim: Brent rose to about $105.64 early September 28 amid continued US-Iran tensions.
records.assessment: Context/evidence only. Price movement does not independently establish a structural delta.
